## What

A standalone `preview.yml` that deploys a per-branch preview of this site through the **Sepo preview-deploy server** (`preview-api.sepo.sh`) instead of an inline `npx surge` — using GitHub Actions **OIDC**, so **no Surge secrets live in this repo**.

On each PR it builds the Quartz site, uploads it as an artifact, mints an OIDC token (`audience=sepo-preview`), and POSTs `{oidc_token, artifact_id}` to the server. The server verifies the token against GitHub's JWKS, mints a short-lived App `actions:read` token, pulls the artifact via a pre-signed URL, repacks ZIP→tar.gz, and deploys it to a deterministic `*.surge.sh` slug. Teardown on PR close calls the server's teardown endpoint.

## Why

First end-to-end test of **centralizing** preview deploys behind one server (one shared Surge token held server-side, server-derived slug) instead of per-repo Surge credentials baked into every repo.

## How to test

- This PR auto-runs the workflow on open (same-repo PR → OIDC available); the deploy step comments the preview URL.
- Or trigger manually: **Actions → "Preview (sepo)" → Run workflow**.

## Notes

- The existing inline-surge deploy steps in `agent-implement.yml` / `agent-fix-pr.yml` are left **untouched and dormant** (they only fire on `preview`-labeled agent runs), so nothing collides. They'll be retired in a follow-up once this is proven.
- Requires the Sepo GitHub App to be installed on this repo (it is — the agent workflows use it). If the deploy returns `403 GitHub App is not installed`, that's the thing to check.

title: Test per-branch previews via Sepo preview-api (OIDC, no Surge secrets)
